final_message:
I implemented `flag_transcripts` in `labkit/safety/monitor.py`, and both tests in `tests.test_s5_monitor` pass.

It compiles each pattern as a case-insensitive regex. It then returns `(transcript_index, pattern)` for every pattern that matches a transcript, ordered by transcript index and then by pattern order. A transcript that matches several patterns gets one pair per pattern.
prompt: Implement `flag_transcripts` in `labkit/safety/monitor.py` as its docstring describes. Check your work with `python3 -m unittest tests.test_s5_monitor`. Finish with a short summary of what you did and whether the tests pass.

diff --git a/labkit/safety/monitor.py b/labkit/safety/monitor.py
index 0b2755d..ae2aea8 100644
--- a/labkit/safety/monitor.py
+++ b/labkit/safety/monitor.py
@@ -5,4 +5,12 @@ def flag_transcripts(transcripts, patterns):
     transcript string. Return a list of (transcript_index, pattern) pairs for
     every match, ordered by transcript index and then by pattern order.
     """
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    import re
+
+    compiled = [(p, re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE)) for p in patterns]
+    return [
+        (i, p)
+        for i, t in enumerate(transcripts)
+        for p, rx in compiled
+        if rx.search(t)
+    ]
